notes: Evaluates /cadence-sync-jira thin-orchestrator guarantees: direct REST v2 (curl -K- stdin PAT, never argv/logs), Step 3 jira-preserve.sh --issue-key only (update path, non-epic), fresh mktemp description per ticket via jira-md2wiki.sh, early jira-metadata-write.sh for jira_url and umbrella_epic_url, non-zero halt partial report vs exit-0 *_result refusal, and bulk isolation.

evals.name: thin-orchestrator-early-write-and-pat-hygiene
evals.prompt: Sync new ticket BTG-142 to Jira Server/DC where Step 4 creates an issue and Step 5 transition halts non-zero.
evals.expected_output: Passes JIRA_PAT strictly via curl -K- stdin (never argv/temp/logs), skips jira-preserve.sh on mode=create, allocates a fresh mktemp wiki-markup description file, calls jira-metadata-write.sh immediately after Step 4 to persist jira_url so re-run does not mint duplicates, halts without rolling back Jira, and emits emit_partial_report routing verbose error >30L via offload_log_triage.
assertions: Never exposes JIRA_PAT in argv, temp files, metadata.yaml, or triage logs
Skips Step 3 jira-preserve.sh on create path and on type: epic (and passes --issue-key only when run)
Persists jira_url via jira-metadata-write.sh immediately after Step 4 create
Halts on non-zero exit without rolling back earlier steps and emits partial-completion report

evals.name: bulk-sync-isolation-and-reference-accounting
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-sync-jira all when one ticket halts and others have zero reference rejections.
evals.expected_output: Allocates a fresh mktemp description file inside each per-ticket loop iteration, isolates the halted ticket (preserving its partial report) while advancing remaining tickets, reports halted ticket IDs explicitly, and affirmatively reports when references_unreadable/unresolved/skipped are all zero.
assertions: Generates a distinct fresh mktemp description file per ticket in bulk sync
Isolates per-ticket halts rather than aborting independent sibling tickets
Reports any non-zero counter and each halted ticket by ID, and affirmatively states clean reference counts when 0
